title: Named normalized integral-matrix pullback data
statement: For the actual integral coefficient object of [def-weil-pbc-continuous-integral-coefficients] and its canonical continuous realization [lem-weil-pbc-continuous-coefficient-realizations], define normalized module pullback, its regular and standard finite-free comparison isomorphisms, and the continuous coefficients of the conjugated pulled-back matrix. The constructions are explicit and involve no choice of unspecified data. Also construct sectionwise continuous-function direct image explicitly and prove its section and unit formulas. The three existing matrix-chart constructions are reexported unchanged from this lower module.

source.place: Section 6.8, Definition 6.8.10 and Proposition 6.8.11(1): integral coefficient framework and kernel-closure application; the displayed continuous-function pivot argument is an agent reduction, not a matrix argument written out in Lemma 6.8.7

proof_origin.place: Section 6.8, continuous coefficient framework; analytic matrix-chart reduction
proof_origin.note: The matrix argument is an agent reduction, not a matrix argument stated in Lemma 6.8.7.
